# macoskeychain_internet_password (Ephemeral Resource)

Reads the password of an internet password item from the macOS Keychain, the kind of item that `security add-internet-password` creates and that browsers and Git credential helpers store. The item is looked up by server and account; when several items match (for example with different protocols or paths), the first match is returned. The password is an ephemeral value: it is never written to a plan or state file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Internet passwords are what `security add-internet-password` creates and what
# Git credential helpers store:
#
#   security add-internet-password -s github.com -a deploy-bot -w

ephemeral "macoskeychain_internet_password" "github" {
  server  = "github.com"
  account = "deploy-bot"
}

provider "github" {
  token = ephemeral.macoskeychain_internet_password.github.password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) Account of the item (the `-a` option of `security add-internet-password`).
- `server` (String) Server of the item, such as `github.com` (the `-s` option of `security add-internet-password`).

### Optional

- `keychain` (String) Absolute path of the keychain file to search, for example `pathexpand("~/Library/Keychains/ci.keychain-db")`. When omitted, the user's keychain search list is searched, as `security find-internet-password` does.

### Read-Only

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the item.
